title: The Garden of the Fugitives
sentences: Thirteen people were running for the gate, and they didn't make it.
They were in a walled garden near the Nocera Gate, at the edge of Pompeii.
Adults and children were climbing over pumice that had piled up for hours.
Then a deadly cloud of hot ash and gas swept in.
In 1961, archaeologists found the hollows their bodies left and filled them with plaster.
The casts still lie where they fell, in the Garden of the Fugitives.
